instructionsBundle.files_note: Populate AGENTS.md from failover-monitor/INSTRUCTIONS.md (identity header + algorithm + 4 gates + HANDOFF/RETURN templates + standard execution contract). Do NOT rely on the top-level 'instructions' string below — managed-bundle adapters read instructionsBundle.files['AGENTS.md'], not 'instructions'.

hire_payload.capabilities: Lightweight infrastructure agent that polls for cloud IC agents stalled on session/usage limits and hands their work to on-box local understudies per the approved pairing map (failover-monitor/PAIRING-MAP.json). Applies four gates: tier (allowlist-only), idempotency (no re-failover), sensitivity (default-deny on NO-FAILOVER/credentials/PII markers), and understudy availability. Posts structured FAILOVER-HANDOFF comments and reassigns assigneeAgentId. Does no domain work itself — API calls only. Woken by cron routine every ~5 min (skip_if_active).
hire_payload.instructions: See failover-monitor/INSTRUCTIONS.md in the project repo. The instructions file contains the full decision-logic algorithm, the four gates, the FAILOVER-HANDOFF comment template, and standing instructions for understudies and cloud agents.

adapter_notes.why: True on-box local — Ollama/Qwen3.6, no cloud session cap, always available when cloud agents are limit-stalled. This is exactly the scenario the Monitor must operate in.
adapter_notes.CORRECTION_2026-06-23: PRIOR ASSUMPTION WAS WRONG. Empty adapterConfig does NOT default to qwen3.6 on this server — it defaults to cloud 'openai/gpt-5.2-codex', which breaks a $0-budget local agent. The live hire (4bd33af1) was created from the empty-config package and came up on the cloud model with generic boilerplate instructions. CTO corrected the live agent via PATCH /api/agents/{id} (model+command+skills+dangerouslySkipPermissions+instructionsBundle+wakeOnDemand) and fixed this package so any future re-hire is correct. Reference agents 9a20c1b5 and 1bb6be46 set model='ollama/qwen3.6:latest' EXPLICITLY — they are not empty-config.

canary_plan.note: Per SAG-4610 gates: canary-first, single proven pairing, 2nd board go before fleet-wide rollout.

recommended_canary_pairing.reason: Same-department SWE pair, well-understood work types, Coder (Qwen3.6) is proven-capable and actively used. Easy to verify handoff quality.

rollout_phases: Phase 1 (canary): Enable for Coder pair only. Verify one real failover end-to-end (trigger, HANDOFF comment, understudy execution, RETURN comment, cloud review).
Phase 2 (2nd board go): Extend to all 8 pairings in PAIRING-MAP.json if canary passes.
Out of scope for SAG-4610: routine creation, live hire, fleet rollout — these are downstream issues.
